title: RepoLens configuration
description: Settings for RepoLens, in repolens.config.json, the "repolens" key of package.json, or the user config file. See https://github.com/Douglas-Strey/repolens-cli/blob/main/docs/configuration.md

ignore.description: Paths to leave out of the scan, in .gitignore syntax, relative to the scanned directory.

maxFiles.description: Stop indexing after this many files. --max-files takes precedence. Default: 100000.

failOn.description: Default for --fail-on: the lowest severity that makes `repolens doctor` exit with 1.

rules.description: Per-check settings by code: "off" turns a check off, a severity replaces the severity of what it finds. A project's own config file can't turn off or lower security checks.

provided.description: Variables your platform or tooling provides; the doctor never expects them in an env file. `*` matches any characters.

output.description: Terminal preferences. Only read from the user config file.

color.description: Colors in terminal output. NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR, --color and --no-color take precedence.

ascii.description: Use ASCII status symbols (+, !, x) instead of Unicode ones.
